newsitem.title: UK: Robert Fleming says makes investment banking hires.
newsitem.headline: Robert Fleming says makes investment banking hires.

text.p: British investment bank Robert Fleming & Co on Wednesday announced two new appointments.
The firm said it had hired Nick Jefcoat, 41, and Hugh Trenchard, 45. Both previously worked for Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, a Robert Fleming spokesman told Reuters.

Jefcoat, who was director of Kleinwort Benson's German investment banking arm in Frankfurt has been hired as a general manager to work alongside Fleming's existing general manager in Frankfurt Heiner Hochstrate.
He will concentrate on building the firm's presence in mergers and acquisitions and equity capital markets.
Trenchard, who was based in London as head of Kleinwort's Japanese investment banking operation, will have a similar role at Flemings, the spokesman said.
